Monica / Sean — read the note. Quick interpretation and recommended approach below: 

Interpretation of SIG Q47 ambiguity:
- The customer language doesn't clearly separate 'human privileged accounts' vs 'service or infra accounts' that have KV/KMS access. Auditor acceptance typically expects both categories to be enumerated.

Proposed evidence package (minimal acceptable):
1) Privilege mapping CSV: columns = role_name | actor_type (human/service) | identity_identifier | onboarding_owner | last_review_date
2) Redacted admin audit extracts: last 90 days (timestamp, actor, action, resource). Redact personal emails and IPs; include request ids to tie to console events.
3) KMS metadata export: key_id, creation_date, last_rotate_date, rotation_policy (pointer to internal doc). We will not export key material.
4) Screenshot + CSV export of IAM role assignment for two representative tenants (hosted + dedicated) — auditors usually accept screenshots plus CSV for sampling.

Constraints: raw log bundles >2GB require SOC/Legal signoff and an NDA addendum. Otherwise provide compressed extracts with sample sizes.

I'll prepare an evidence_matrix.xlsx that maps SIG Q47 sub-clauses to the artifacts above and flags where redaction is needed. Can deliver draft matrix within 24 hours after the call. If we align on scope on Wed, target delivery of final artifacts by Tue 28 Jul.
